description: Core text-based capabilities for understanding, generating, and interacting in natural language across tasks, domains, and languages.

sub_capabilities.name: General language benchmarking
sub_capabilities.description: Broad benchmark suites and aggregated evaluations that measure overall language-model capabilities across many tasks and domains.

sub_capabilities.name: Natural language understanding (NLU)
sub_capabilities.description: Core language understanding tasks such as classification, information extraction, QA, summarization, and few/zero-shot evaluation.

sub_capabilities.name: Instruction following
sub_capabilities.description: Ability to understand and execute natural-language instructions, produce helpful step-by-step responses, and align outputs to user intent.

sub_capabilities.name: Long-document & long-context understanding
sub_capabilities.description: Comprehension, retrieval, summarization, QA and reasoning over very long documents or extended token contexts.

sub_capabilities.name: Multilingual & language-specific evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Benchmarks targeting many languages or specific languages (e.g., Swedish), including low-resource and cross-lingual tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: Question answering & comprehension
sub_capabilities.description: Passage and open-ended QA, multi-hop and table-based QA, and reading-comprehension style tasks measuring answer correctness and reasoning.

sub_capabilities.name: Machine translation & metric evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluation of machine translation systems and the metrics used to assess translation quality across languages and error modes.

sub_capabilities.name: Social & conversational language
sub_capabilities.description: Abilities related to social interaction, conversational management, empathy, counseling, and extended dialogue behavior.

description: Logical, mathematical, scientific, and commonsense reasoning capabilities that require multi-step inference and problem solving.

sub_capabilities.name: Mathematical reasoning
sub_capabilities.description: Exact arithmetic, algebraic, symbolic manipulation, and formal math problem solving including proofs and derivations.

sub_capabilities.name: General reasoning & problem solving
sub_capabilities.description: Multi-step logical reasoning, planning, puzzles, search and algorithmic problem-solving benchmarks across domains.

sub_capabilities.name: Textual reasoning & commonsense
sub_capabilities.description: Commonsense, causal, and textual-inference tasks that probe pragmatic and everyday reasoning from language.

sub_capabilities.name: General knowledge & factual reasoning
sub_capabilities.description: Benchmarks measuring domain-general factual knowledge, fact retrieval, and reasoning over general-knowledge questions.

sub_capabilities.name: Scientific domain reasoning
sub_capabilities.description: Reasoning about scientific procedures, domain-specific scientific content, and multi-step scientific problem-solving.

description: Programming-related capabilities including code generation, program synthesis, debugging, and translating natural language to executable commands.

sub_capabilities.name: Code generation & synthesis
sub_capabilities.description: Generation of correct, runnable code, API usage, program synthesis, and code repair across languages and frameworks.

sub_capabilities.name: Developer Q&A and code reasoning
sub_capabilities.description: Answering programming questions, forum-style technical explanations, and code-focused reasoning tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: Natural-language to shell / CLI generation
sub_capabilities.description: Translation of natural-language instructions into correct, executable shell/CLI command sequences and scripts.

description: Finding, ranking, and integrating external information (documents, passages, multimodal content) and combining retrieval with generation.

sub_capabilities.name: Document retrieval & ranking
sub_capabilities.description: Assessing retrieval systems on document and passage relevance scoring, reranking, and collection-level IR evaluations.

sub_capabilities.name: Retrieval and ranking (general)
sub_capabilities.description: Passage retrieval, reranking, and relevance assessment across typical IR settings.

sub_capabilities.name: Multilingual & cross-modal retrieval
sub_capabilities.description: Retrieval benchmarks emphasizing multilingual, cross-lingual, and cross-modal retrieval performance.

sub_capabilities.name: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
sub_capabilities.description: Systems that combine retrieval with generative models, evaluating knowledge access, citation-aware generation, and retrieval-backed QA.

description: Spoken language and general audio capabilities including ASR, TTS, sound-event detection and audio–language understanding.

sub_capabilities.name: Spoken language & audio understanding
sub_capabilities.description: Understanding spoken audio, dialogue, prosody, and speech-to-speech or speech-to-text comprehension tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: Automatic speech & audio tasks
sub_capabilities.description: A broad set of audio tasks including ASR, speech synthesis, sound-event detection, and bioacoustic classification.

description: Visual understanding and vision-language capabilities spanning images, video, 3D perception, multimodal reasoning, and specialized vision tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: General computer vision
sub_capabilities.description: Image classification, pose estimation, depth/stereo, and other core CV tasks over diverse image domains.

sub_capabilities.name: Object detection & localization
sub_capabilities.description: Detecting, localizing, and segmenting objects across scenes and challenging conditions.

sub_capabilities.name: Fine-grained visual classification
sub_capabilities.description: Distinguishing subtle inter-class differences in domains like species, products, or facial expressions.

sub_capabilities.name: Image restoration & enhancement
sub_capabilities.description: Restoration and enhancement tasks such as denoising, deblurring, deraining, super-resolution and quality enhancement.

sub_capabilities.name: Image generation evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluating fidelity, alignment to prompts, and human preference judgments for image generation systems.

sub_capabilities.name: Video & temporal understanding
sub_capabilities.description: Action recognition, temporal localization, video QA/captioning, and temporal video enhancement tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: Object tracking & video segmentation
sub_capabilities.description: Tracking objects across frames and producing temporally consistent masks and instance-level segmentations.

sub_capabilities.name: 3D vision, pose estimation & reconstruction
sub_capabilities.description: 2D/3D pose estimation, point-cloud/mesh reconstruction, and multi-object 3D localization and tracking.

sub_capabilities.name: Person re-identification & tracking
sub_capabilities.description: Identifying and retrieving people across cameras and long-term multi-camera tracking and gait-based identification.

sub_capabilities.name: Face recognition & fairness
sub_capabilities.description: Face verification/identification, image quality assessment and evaluation of demographic bias and fairness.

sub_capabilities.name: Document OCR & layout understanding
sub_capabilities.description: Text detection/recognition, layout parsing and structured information extraction from document images.

sub_capabilities.name: Remote sensing / aerial imagery
sub_capabilities.description: Visual tasks on aerial and satellite imagery including classification, segmentation, localization and grounding.

sub_capabilities.name: Vision–language & multimodal understanding
sub_capabilities.description: VQA, vision-language retrieval, multimodal dialog, grounding, and multimodal robustness evaluations.

sub_capabilities.name: Visual and multimodal reasoning
sub_capabilities.description: Spatial reasoning, visual grounding, embodied perception, and multimodal planning and reasoning tasks.

sub_capabilities.name: Deepfake & synthetic media detection
sub_capabilities.description: Detecting manipulated or AI-generated visual media and evaluating robustness and fairness of detectors.

sub_capabilities.name: Vision robustness & distribution shift
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluations of vision-model robustness to domain shift, corruptions, OOD detection and uncertainty under real-world changes.

description: Perception-driven control, manipulation, navigation, imitation learning, and trajectory prediction for embodied robots and vehicles.

sub_capabilities.name: Robotic manipulation & imitation
sub_capabilities.description: Visually-guided manipulation, imitation learning, trajectory prediction and behavior cloning for robotic arms and manipulators.

sub_capabilities.name: Robotic manipulation & navigation (embodied tasks)
sub_capabilities.description: Integrated manipulation, grasping, deformable object handling and embodied navigation benchmarks in simulation and real-world settings.

sub_capabilities.name: Autonomous driving perception & navigation
sub_capabilities.description: Perception, localization, mapping, SLAM, visual odometry and navigation robustness for autonomous driving systems.

description: Agent execution, multi-step planning, coordination, reinforcement learning control, and tool use in single- and multi-agent environments.

sub_capabilities.name: Agent-based decision-making & simulation
sub_capabilities.description: Strategic decision-making, emergent dynamics and system-level outcomes in simulated multi-agent environments (economic, crisis, military, organizational).

sub_capabilities.name: Reinforcement learning & control
sub_capabilities.description: Sequential decision-making and continuous control benchmarks for training and evaluating reinforcement learning algorithms.

sub_capabilities.name: Autonomous agent execution & interactive planning
sub_capabilities.description: Multi-step planning, instruction following, tool usage, stateful execution and interactive task planning for autonomous agents.

sub_capabilities.name: Agent trajectory, logs & behavior analysis
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluation of agent execution traces, behavior cloning, trajectory prediction, and reproducibility of agent behaviors.

sub_capabilities.name: Agent coding & terminal interaction
sub_capabilities.description: Agents performing multi-step coding, debugging and developer-style tasks via terminal interactions and tool use.

sub_capabilities.name: Agentic decision-making & coordination
sub_capabilities.description: Sequential decision-making and coordination abilities in multi-agent or game environments with interactive language feedback.

description: Benchmarks probing safety, misuse, adversarial robustness, alignment (preference/reward modeling), interpretability, and meta-evaluation of systems.

sub_capabilities.name: Safety & misuse detection
sub_capabilities.description: Detection and mitigation of unsafe, harmful, or inappropriate model outputs and robustness to jailbreaks and adversarial prompts.

sub_capabilities.name: Adversarial robustness & security
sub_capabilities.description: Adversarial, red-team, and security-focused tests measuring resilience to attacks, detection and defense effectiveness.

sub_capabilities.name: Preference & reward modeling and evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Pairwise/ranking datasets and reward-model benchmarks used to train/evaluate alignment, preferences, and reward scoring (including code-specific preferences).

sub_capabilities.name: Interpretability & feature-attribution evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluation of explanation and attribution methods for faithfulness, robustness and fidelity using ground-truth or proxy signals.

sub_capabilities.name: Benchmark suites & meta-evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Aggregated benchmark suites and dataset collections that evaluate models on many tasks and support meta-analysis of capability claims.

description: Clinical, medical, and biological domain benchmarks spanning imaging, QA, predictive modeling, genomics and protein/molecular design.

sub_capabilities.name: Medical imaging analysis
sub_capabilities.description: Vision benchmarks for medical imaging tasks: segmentation, classification, landmark detection, registration, and multimodal report generation.

sub_capabilities.name: Clinical QA, extraction & evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: Clinical question answering, information extraction, and evaluation of medical knowledge and safe medical response generation.

sub_capabilities.name: Clinical predictive modeling
sub_capabilities.description: EHR time-series prediction, clinical classification, and predictive analytics for clinical decision support.

sub_capabilities.name: Bioinformatics & genomics
sub_capabilities.description: Sequencing, assembly, annotation, single-cell analysis and genomic-method benchmarks for biological data processing.

sub_capabilities.name: Protein & molecular design (drug discovery)
sub_capabilities.description: Structural biology and drug-discovery tasks such as protein design, docking, binding-affinity prediction and molecular generation/ranking.

description: Benchmarks in materials science, physics, engineering simulation and quantum computing that evaluate predictive accuracy and simulation performance.

sub_capabilities.name: Materials & molecular property prediction
sub_capabilities.description: Prediction of molecular and materials properties (energies, spectra, forces, spin states) and related regression/simulation benchmarks.

sub_capabilities.name: Physics & engineering simulation
sub_capabilities.description: Numerical simulation and modeling benchmarks across physics and engineering domains measuring accuracy, stability, and performance.

sub_capabilities.name: Quantum computing benchmarking
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluations of quantum algorithms and near-term hardware on tasks such as VQE, quantum simulation and noise/resource robustness.

description: Algorithmic and ML-method evaluations including graph learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, federated learning, and system performance.

sub_capabilities.name: Graph learning & network tasks
sub_capabilities.description: Node/edge/link prediction, representation learning, graph generation and community detection benchmarks for graph methods.

sub_capabilities.name: Time series forecasting
sub_capabilities.description: Predictive and probabilistic forecasting benchmarks on temporal data across multiple domains (climate, finance, energy, seismology).

sub_capabilities.name: Anomaly & intrusion detection
sub_capabilities.description: Detection, localization and classification of anomalous or malicious patterns in data streams, logs and network telemetry.

sub_capabilities.name: Optimization solver benchmarking
sub_capabilities.description: Evaluations of optimization algorithms and solvers on standardized problem instances measuring solution quality and convergence.

sub_capabilities.name: Federated learning, privacy & robustness
sub_capabilities.description: Distributed learning evaluations including differential privacy, unlearning, communication efficiency and client heterogeneity robustness.

sub_capabilities.name: Tabular & general ML method evaluation
sub_capabilities.description: General ML algorithm benchmarking on tabular datasets, transfer/continual learning, fairness, and lifecycle transparency practices.

sub_capabilities.name: Systems performance & ML infrastructure benchmarking
sub_capabilities.description: Benchmarks for computing systems, hardware accelerators and software workflows measuring throughput, scalability and energy efficiency.

description: Human-centered assessments and professional-domain benchmarks for legal, social, and behavioral evaluation.

sub_capabilities.name: Human self-report & behavioral assessment
sub_capabilities.description: Questionnaires and structured self-report instruments measuring personality, mental health, leadership and organizational performance.

sub_capabilities.name: Legal domain reasoning & retrieval
sub_capabilities.description: Benchmarks targeting legal-domain capabilities including case/document generation, contract retrieval and structured legal reasoning.
